raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Beginner Strength (Bodyweight + Pull-Up Bar)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Foundational full-body strength with bodyweight and pull-up bar"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundations" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x25..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 6x1..3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x7..9 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x25..35 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x9..11 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x14..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 6x2..3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x30..40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..18 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..18 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 6x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 4x10..14 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload Push + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x25..40 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x1..2 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..14 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x7..9 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..55 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          squat 4x12..16 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x14..18 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 4x14..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 7x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 3x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x12..16 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 4x7..11 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x9..11 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          squat 4x14..18 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 4x16..22 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull Emphasis":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 7x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 4x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x10..16 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 5x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 4x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Volume":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 5x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          squat 5x12..18 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x12..18 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 5x14..22 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 8x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 5x2..4 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 5x10..14 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 5x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload Push":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x35..50 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 5x2..3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 3x1..3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Consolidation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Strength":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 6x12..18 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          squat 5x14..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 5x16..24 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Strength + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 8x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 4x12..16 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Density":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 7x12..18 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 5x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_dip 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Density":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 5x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          squat 5x16..22 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x16..22 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 5x18..26 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Density + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 8x5..6 rpe 8 rest 105 seconds
          chin_up 5x4..5 rpe 8 rest 105 seconds
          inverted_row 5x12..16 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x14..18 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Push Peak Volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 8x12..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 6x8..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_dip 6x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 4x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Peak Volume":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 6x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          squat 6x16..24 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 6x16..22 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 6x18..26 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pull Peak Volume + Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 9x5..7 rpe 8 rest 105 seconds
          chin_up 6x4..6 rpe 8 rest 105 seconds
          inverted_row 6x12..16 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 4x16..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload + Test Push":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_dip 2x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload + Test Lower":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload + Test Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 6x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..14 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12..16 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
